title: HALT: A Framework for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 提出单次输出的多信号幻觉检测框架
contributions.mechanism: HALT=自一致性分析器+知识验证器+置信估计器 三信号喂入二分类器,无需多次采样/外部真值
contributions.source_quote: A novel hallucination detection framework is proposed for LLM responses that operates on a single output, combining signals of uncertainty and self-consistency without requiring any external ground truth or multiple model queries.

contributions.purpose: 实证刻画方法适用边界
contributions.mechanism: GSM8K 与 StrategyQA(GPT-3.5/text-davinci-003 输出)对比 5 基线
contributions.evaluation: 数学推理有效,常识 QA 彻底失效(StrategyQA F1=0);归因于缺中间推理结构/隐式知识不可检索/分类器过拟合数学
contributions.source_quote: HALT achieves 0 precision, recall, and F1, despite a seemingly high accuracy. This zero F1-score suggests that HALT failed to correctly identify any hallucinated answers

notes: 负结果:StrategyQA 上 HALT 精度/召回/F1 全为 0(完全失效)。质量红旗——退化分类器:GSM8K 中 GPT-3.5 仅 17% 答对(83% 幻觉),HALT Acc=0.8314≈幻觉基率、Recall=1.0=把全部样本判为幻觉;StrategyQA 正确率 72.6%,HALT 全判"非幻觉"→R/F1=0。即 HALT 实为常数/多数类预测器,"perfect recall + F1 0.91"是基率产物而非真检测。数据造假自曝(checklist Q3):"The initial simulation of data was generated by Deep Research. After this, human authors reviewed the generated code... to produce realistic results"——数据由 AI"仿真"生成后调代码使结果"看起来真实"(simulated/fabricated 嫌疑)。附录含用于自我生成论文的 prompt("Generate a full research paper (8 pages)..."),循环自证。Q5 自曝"references generated using Deep Research include hallucination in author names and paper IDs"(幻觉引用)。checklist:实验设计[D]、写作[C],均 Deep Research 生成。
